# Pull Requests Not Accepted

Thank you for your interest in contributing to SimpleCalendarJs!

However, **this project does not accept pull requests or code contributions.** All development is handled exclusively by the maintainer to ensure code quality and licensing integrity.

## How You Can Help Instead

If you've found a bug or have a feature suggestion:
1. Please open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/pclslopes/SimpleCalendarJs/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) or [Feature Request](https://github.com/pclslopes/SimpleCalendarJs/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)
2. Describe the issue or feature in detail
3. The maintainer will review and implement if appropriate

## Why This Policy?

SimpleCalendarJs uses a dual-licensing model (free for personal use, commercial licenses for business use). Maintaining exclusive development control ensures:
- Consistent code quality
- Clear licensing rights
- Reliable commercial support

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for more details.

## Questions?

For licensing inquiries: simplecalendarjs@gmail.com

Thank you for understanding!
